column1: # Database migration manifest for the consolidated PostgreSQL instance.
# One row per source database that will be converged into the target instance.
#   target_db    name the database will have in the consolidated instance
#   role         the Postgres role that owns it (== the app's DB user)
#   source       source instance: a k3s LoadBalancer IP, or "internal:pgvector"
#   source_db    the database name on the source (differs from target_db only
#                where a rename resolved a name conflict)
#   size         approximate source size (for planning / verification)
# Name conflicts (a database name present on more than one source instance
# cannot exist twice in one server) are resolved by renaming the LEGACY copy
# (the one whose app is no longer running) and preserving it so no data is lost:
# Both k3s `homeassistant` DBs and the `penpot` server are no longer running on
# k3s (HA migrated to Talos using SQLite; penpot ns has only an exporter), so
# these renamed copies are preserved for safety, not actively wired to an app.
# The per-source `postgres` template/maintenance DB is intentionally NOT listed
